name: hud_ui_timer_panel_float_draw
description: HudUiTimerPanelFloat::Draw invalidates the panel, formats the display float as %2.1f through the panel ftable, then draws the base HudUiPanel.
known_limits: Tier C only; tier S comparison is deferred to a HUD timer panel ftable/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x40f040 validates ftable slot 0x20 invalidate dispatch, x87 promotion of displayValue at offset 0x2a8 to a stack double, cdecl SetTextFmt dispatch through ftable slot 0x74 with format %2.1f, and final HudUiPanel::Draw call.

The native timer-panel-float draw smoke verifies Draw dispatches Invalidate and SetTextFmt virtually with the display double and reaches HudUiPanel::Draw by observing dirty text rebuild through the virtual RebuildTextRect slot.
